Ava Patel: Quick quarterly pattern review. I aggregated recurring incident signals across the past 90 days and want owners + timelines.

Ava Patel: Top signals:
1) GPU cold-start latency on scale-ups
2) KV/prefix cache rebuild storms
3) Autoscaler oscillation on noisy-worker pools
4) Rare quantized decode stalls for long-context streams
5) Rate-limiter burst impacts on routed customers

Jon Chen: Please paste the aggregation command so oncall can reproduce.

Ava Patel: Query used (simplified):
SELECT signal, count(*) AS hits, approx_percentile(latency,0.95) AS p95 FROM infra.events WHERE env='prod' AND ts>now()-interval '90 days' GROUP BY signal ORDER BY hits DESC;

Priya Singh: I'll take KV/prefix rebuilds. Plan: synthetic replay to repro, add verbose tracing, prototype a stale-serving fallback guarded by a feature flag. ETA: repro + plan by next Thu.

Zoe Martinez: I will pair on the fallback and help scope safety. ETA: feature flag + short doc by next Mon.

Jon Chen: I'll own autoscaler thrash. Short-term: bump stabilization window, cap immediate scale bursts, add oscillation alert. PR by Tue, dashboard follow-up after.

IncidentBot: Created INC-2101 "KV prefix rebuild - recurring" and linked to thread.

Ava Patel: Actions recap: Priya INC-2101 repro+POA, Zoe fallback flag+doc, Jon autoscaler config PR, Ava/Kai dig into GPU warmup traces and driver correlation. 15-min sync next Wed to confirm. If you can't make it, drop updates here.

Priya Singh: I'll post repro logs in INC-2101 when ready.

Ava Patel: Thanks all. Ping #eng-oncall for urgent items.
